annotator_2.scope: all 453 sample items; the gate uses this annotator as a2 regardless of its labels

approved_by: owner (SebasHT15), 2026-10-19: 'Approve option A: pre-register claude-haiku-5-5 as annotator 2 for all 453 items with the same protocol (one retry per batch, no fallback). Move the Opus 5.5 partial to a supplementary slot, descriptive only.'

protocol.batches: 6 consecutive batches of 76 (last 73), identical boundaries and files to the earlier a2 batches
protocol.isolation: one fresh read-only agent per batch; Read only its batch file and annotation_a2/README.md
protocol.model_check: every assistant turn must be served by claude-haiku-5-5; any fallback or other model makes the attempt REFUSED
protocol.packet: annotation_a2/packet.jsonl, byte-identical to the packet drawn for a2 (sha256 in annotation_packets.json)
protocol.retry: at most one retry per batch with the identical prompt and a fresh agent; no rewording, splitting or prompt change
protocol.stop_rule: if any batch has no ACCEPTED attempt after its retry, annotation stops; the round stays PENDING_ANNOTATION and moves to option B (owner)

selection_rule: No annotator is chosen after comparing agreement; this file is written and hashed before the first Haiku agent runs.

supplementary.use: descriptive only; never enters the gate, the adjudication or the acceptance report
